description: Book snow plowing in the North Jersey area for a real person who asked for it, with their consent. need.description: What they need (e.g. per push driveway plowing; seasonal snow plowing contract; sidewalk and walkway shoveling)

phone.description: US phone number the pro should call (10 digits, any punctuation)

preferred_time.description: When they prefer a call or visit (optional)
